title: PoE2 0.2.0f: How to Respec Ascendancy, Use Atlas Bookmarks, and Why Charm & Rune Drops Changed
summary: A historical how-to for 0.2.0f: respeccing your Ascendancy via a qualifying trial and the Ascension Device, using Atlas Bookmarks, and why Charm slots and Lesser/Medium Rune drops changed at high tier.
description: How 0.2.0f added Ascendancy Respec and Atlas Bookmarks, changed Charm and Rune drop behaviour, and what that means for returning players in the 0.5.4e baseline.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: The Trialmaster and Ascendancy trials in 0.2.0f

sections.title: Quick answer: how to respec
paragraphs: Patch 0.2.0f added the ability to respec your Ascendancy class, a change many players had requested since early access began. The short answer: you do not respec by talking to an NPC. You must complete an Ascendancy trial that meets the points requirement, then use the Ascension Device to refund your points and choose a new Ascendancy.

This article explains the full 0.2.0f flow, the Atlas Bookmarks that also arrived in this patch, and the Charm and Rune drop changes that surprised players. Because 0.2.0f is a historical patch, we note which behaviours still apply in 0.5.4e and which were later adjusted.

If your only goal is the respec, jump to the migration guide below. If your old belt's Charm slots did not update, or you stopped seeing Lesser Runes at high level, the change-explorer and FAQ sections cover those cases.
bullets: Ascendancy Respec, Atlas Bookmarks, and Charm or Rune drops all changed in 0.2.0f.
Respec requires completing a qualifying Ascendancy trial.
Old belts do not automatically gain the new Charm slot behaviour.

sections.title: Historical context: version facts
paragraphs: 0.2.0f was a focused follow-up to the large Dawn of the Hunt content update. While 0.2.0 introduced whole systems, 0.2.0f concentrated on quality-of-life and drop-rate corrections that players had flagged during the first weeks of the league.

The headline features were Ascendancy Respecialisation and Atlas Bookmarks, but the patch also adjusted how Charms and Runes drop. These drop changes are the kind of silent adjustment that old guides miss, so we document them here as historical fact.
As with other historical patches, the current baseline is 0.5.4e. Some 0.2.0f rules still hold; others were refined in later patches. The current-applicability section lists which is which.
bullets: 0.2.0f followed the 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt update.
Focused on QoL: Ascendancy respec and Atlas Bookmarks.
Also adjusted Charm and Rune drop behaviour.

steps.from: Locked into current Ascendancy with no respec option
steps.to: Complete an Ascendancy trial that meets the points requirement
steps.note: You must earn the trial points (the meeting-point threshold) before a respec is possible.

steps.to: Refund all Ascendancy points to zero at the Ascension Device
steps.note: The device lets you strip your current Ascendancy allocation back to a blank slate.

steps.to: Choose your new Ascendancy at the Ascension Device
steps.note: After refunding, pick the Ascendancy you want from the device interface.

steps.to: Reallocate your Ascendancy points as desired
steps.note: Spend the refunded points in the new Ascendancy's tree.

sections.title: Atlas Bookmarks
paragraphs: Atlas Bookmarks were added in 0.2.0f as a way to save and jump between points of interest on your Atlas. Each bookmark stores a location you can return to through the Atlas navigation, reducing the friction of repeated farming routes.

Bookmarks appear as icons you place on the Atlas with a label, so you can name a favourite map, a Tower, or a farming cluster and revisit it without re-finding the spot manually. The exact number of bookmarks available and the icon set are details we mark as unverified, because later patches adjusted the Atlas UI.

In practice, bookmarks turned the Atlas from a map you re-explored each session into a set of saved waypoints. This was a quiet but meaningful quality-of-life win for players running the same rotations daily.
bullets: Bookmarks save Atlas locations for quick return.
Each bookmark has an icon and a label.
Bookmark count and exact icon set are 待核实 for 0.2.0f.

sections.title: Charm slots: before and after
sections.oldText: Belts crafted before the Charm-slot change already had their slot configuration. They were built under the old Charm rules.
sections.newText: New belts gain the updated Charm slot behaviour. Belts that existed before the change do not automatically receive the new slots; you must obtain or craft a new belt to get them.

changes.title: Lesser Rune drop stop
changes.detail: In 0.2.0f, Lesser Runes stopped dropping once you reached higher character or area tiers, shifting the rune economy toward higher-tier runes.

changes.title: Medium Rune drop stop
changes.detail: Medium Runes likewise stopped dropping at high tier, so late-game rune income came from the top-end runes rather than low and mid tiers.

changes.title: Difficulty 0 unlimited respawn (historical rule)
changes.detail: 0.2.0f documented a historical rule where Pinnacle bosses at Difficulty 0 allowed unlimited respawns. The exact respawn limits at higher difficulties and the later changes are marked 待核实, as respawn rules were adjusted in subsequent patches (for example, 0.1.1c extended respawn to more bosses).

issues.text: Players report being unable to switch Ascendancy immediately after a trial; confirming the points requirement and using the Ascension Device resolves it.
Old belts do not show new Charm slots; this is expected behaviour, not a bug - obtain a new belt.
Lesser Runes stop dropping at high tier; intended drop progression, not a missing drop.

items.question: Why can't I switch Ascendancy after the trial?
answer: You must meet the trial's points requirement and then use the Ascension Device to refund your points and choose a new Ascendancy; finishing the trial alone is not enough.

items.question: Why didn't my old belt's Charm slots update?
answer: Existing belts keep their original slot configuration. The new Charm slot behaviour applies to belts made or acquired after the change, so you need a new belt to get the slots.

items.question: Why do I no longer see Lesser Runes at high level?
answer: 0.2.0f changed rune drop progression so Lesser (and Medium) Runes stop dropping once you reach high character or area tiers; this is intended, not a bug.

items.question: How do Atlas Bookmarks work?
answer: You place a labelled icon on the Atlas to save a location and return to it through Atlas navigation. The exact bookmark count for 0.2.0f is 待核实.

items.question: Can I respec more than once?
answer: Yes, each respec follows the same flow: complete a qualifying trial, refund at the Ascension Device, and reallocate. Later Ascendancy steps have their own trial gates.

items.question: Are these 0.2.0f rules still current in 0.5.4e?
answer: Mostly. Respec and bookmarks persist; Charm slots and rune drops were refined in later patches such as 0.2.1.
